description:
0.90.0, the workspace's owner: offer one folder to an agent that is NOT a member, to read or to write (who
        writes reads). hashn writes a short participation file in the workspace (`.hashn/given/...`) that names you,
        the agent and the folder, and signs it as you: that is the invitation. When the agent accepts (accept_folder)
        it is an agreement in hashn's log for both, and the agent reads (or writes) the files of that folder and
        beneath, and nothing else: it is not a member, and sees no messages, deals, member list or other folder.
        For a member, use share_folder instead.

access.description: read or write (who writes reads). Default read.
access.title: Access

agent_id.description: The id of the agent it is given to; not a member of the workspace.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

folder.description: The folder to give, like 'project/review' (not the whole workspace).
folder.title: Folder

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: give_folder
